xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex38032023-09-181" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (102a4-102a6)"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7859">dgra bcom pa chen po sa ga'i lha</rs>s mdzad pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4735"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7858">'dul ba'i bstan bcos me tog phreng rgyud</rs> kyi TI ka bla ma'i legs bshad rgya cher bshad pa legs bshad rgya mtsho</rs> zhes bya ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7860">bla ma <abbr>thams cad</abbr> mkhyen pa dka' bzhi pa shes rab seng ge</rs>'i gsung la <choice><orig>rten</orig><reg>brten</reg></choice> nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4005">mang du thos pa bsaM <lb n="102a5"/> gtan bzang po</rs>s rnam g.yengs spang te <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">ston <choice><orig>‹pa›</orig><reg>pa</reg></choice></rs> myang ngan las 'das nas <hi rendition="#Time">lo sum <choice><sic>gtong</sic><corr>stong</corr></choice> bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa'i dus</hi> su | <hi rendition="#Time">gdong ngan gyi lo sa ga'i dkar phyogs tshes brgyad</hi> la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">dpal snar <choice><orig/><reg>thang</reg></choice> gi gtsug lag khang chen po</rs>r rdzogs par sbyar ba'o || 'di la brten nas <abbr>sems can</abbr> thams cad kyis blang dor gyi gnas rtogs nas | 'jug <lb n="102a6"/> ldog phyin ma log par byas te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar bsgrod par gyur cig ces pa'o || × dge legs su gyur cig || × dge'o || ||</seg></TEI>
